name: 白腰文鳥

similarSpecies.distinction: 成鳥白腹有明顯暗色鱗狀斑，不具白腰；幼鳥較難分。
此圖為黑頭型成鳥，黑頭栗腹而非白腹白腰；台灣型頭部較褐。

rangeMap.note: Full world viewport, but only a partial native-country overview: Nepal/India through Southeast Asia to Sumatra, southern and eastern China and Taiwan, plus Sri Lanka/Bhutan in the broader South Asian range. Native occurrence is local, not the whole shaded country. Indonesia shading does not mean all islands; introduced populations, seasons and subspecies not mapped.
